label: nyiso 52 floor rederive
definition: (PROBE — KEEPER-CANDIDATE pending #1344, NOT a keeper swap) NYISO CT/ST reliability-floor re-derivation (rule 17/18/23) + nyiso_downstate_ct_gas_basis=True (the PR #1427 delivered-fuel city-gate premium, kept default-off); one-delta vs nyiso-48 head-regate + the floors config, all years 2023-2025. Floors: NYC CT 24h hot step DISABLED (r1_disabled, D-4 off-window binder) + LI local self-supply NARROWED to the HB14-21 peak window (0.45 level unchanged; hours only). RESULT: strongest candidate yet. CT_PEAKER 4.46/4.51/4.73 -> 2.02/2.33/2.91 TWh (actual 2.26/2.13/2.84) — near-exact all 3 years; C1 CT_PEAKER in band, free-class 9/10 (remaining fail = 2024 ST_GAS -3.30, the pre-existing steam under-run). C7 diurnal (D-1) PASS all years (2024 CT_PEAKER off-peak cv_ratio 0.454 -> 3.47, r 0.84). self-supply CT forcing halved; reliability-floor CT overnight energy = 0.000. NOT YET a keeper: rule-20 D-2 CT_PEAKER forced-share still >10% (reliability alone 45.8/54.5/39.3% — HIGHER share because the dearer downstate gas shrinks the economic-CT denominator) and C3a -13.5/-14.7/-12.5% (improved from -17/-18/-15 by the gas premium, still out of band) / C3c 0/0/7h — both now cleanly the missing #1344 peaker-scarcity/reserve price structure, the SAME root cause (CT peakers stay economically idle without it, so the floors carry the CT commitment and the tail never prices). D-4 residual (~34%) is entirely hour 14 (0 overnight) — the h15-21 vs HB14-21 window-boundary artifact, not off-window binding. Recommended eventual NYISO keeper config once #1344 lands. Rules 1/13/17/18/23; keeper stays nyiso-41 STALE-VS-HEAD, keepers.json unchanged.
